|lore=Scoundrel and gambler. Petty administrator of a small Tibanna gas mining operation. Easily coerced. Has problems of his own. Had dealings with the Tonnika Sisters – twice.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn while at a battleground, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from any just drawn destiny. Once per turn may ▲ A Real Hero.

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster reduces power from 5 to 3 and forfeit from 7 to 4. The contemporary issuer full image and slip both retain the broad just-drawn destiny adjustment and A Real Hero pull, with the same deploy, ability and Pilot/Warrior icons. Legacy Block 2 prints the later narrower adjustment without A Real Hero. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071127053958id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v6/ds/landocalrissian.gif Set 6 Players Committee full image, captured 27 November 2007]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Separate Legacy Block 2 #14E].
